# STREPTOCOCCAL INFECTIONS IN BONE OR JOINT PROSTHESES

For acute, moderate or severe infections, treat with intravenous antibiotics

followed by oral antibiotics. Mild infections can be treated with oral

antibiotics only.

Consult Infectious Diseases for specific management advice.

# Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases for specific management advice.

# Duration of Treatment

Treat for a total duration of 4-6 weeks. Chronic suppression with oral

antimicrobials may follow treatment based on individual patient circumstances.

# Intravenous Treatment

Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS.

# Oral Treatment For Mild Infections, Continuation of Therapy or Chronic

# Suppression

[Amoxicillin 500 mg PO TID \($\) R](psozid-amoxicillin-500-mg-po-tid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-amoxicillin-500-mg-po-tid)
